phi_calibration.note: Phi (22->64->1) predicts sigma (expected |epsilon|). r=0.701 on held-out transitions; r_cross=0.730 on unseen motor violations (OOD). See paper Table 1 and Fig phi.

phi_functional.definition: presence = epsilon / (sigma_Phi^2 + 1e-6). Low ratio means expected noise is attenuated vs true violation.

phi_causal.note: Phi-coupled epistemic action (leave fog when att_visual<0.35 or mean att 1:5 >0.65) halves fog exposure.

phi_architecture.input_breakdown: 13 (vis 2 + H_norm 4 + action 7) + 7 atten weights + 2 eps stats (mean, std)
phi_architecture.attention_training: Adam 1e-3, 300 steps, MSE sigma_mean vs eps + 0.01 entropy regularizer; sigma_canal = RUIDO_BASE + (RUIDO_NIEBLA - RUIDO_BASE)*atten_weights (7-dim vector, channel 6 half noise)
phi_architecture.ewc: lambda=5.0, fisher 0.9*F+0.1*g^2, updated online, w_star refreshed every 5000 steps
